instructions: Set an oven rack in the top position and heat the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Split the 4 English muffins with a fork and lay the halves on the sheet, cut side up.
Broil for about 1 minute, until the tops are golden.
Flip them and broil for about 1 minute, until the bottoms are crisp. Watch them closely. Broilers vary.
Turn them cut side up again. Divide the 1 cup marinara between the 8 halves and spread it almost to the edges.
Divide the 1 cup mozzarella between them, then sprinkle on the 1 tbsp Parmesan and the 1/4 tsp oregano.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until the cheese is melted, bubbling and browned in spots. This makes 8 mini pizzas.
Leave them for a minute, then serve them warm.
method_notes: Both toast split English muffins first so they stay crisp, then top them with marinara, mozzarella and oregano and cook them until the cheese bubbles. Once Upon a Chef (the lead, since neither page has 20 ratings) does it all under the broiler with 1 cup each of sauce and mozzarella and a little Parmesan for 8 halves. Jo Cooks bakes them at 375°F for 10 to 12 minutes with twice the mozzarella and some garlic powder. This follows the lead but leaves off its pepperoni, so these are plain cheese pizzas.
